problems: e1: socket ↔ socket is not a compatible pair
notes: The MKR WiFi 1010 is in the catalogue but has no JST port; the battery's JST connector is mapped to the board's 'USB' port as the nearest available connector port. A dedicated JST port would be better.

The photo shows the pushbutton straddling the breadboard centre gap at column 8. The black wire ends on the top half (column 8, row e area) and the yellow wire on the bottom half (column 8, row e). Exact rows are inferred from the image.
Pushbutton legs are mapped to 1.l (top half) and 2.l (bottom half), so the button bridges the centre gap.
The manual says the pushbutton goes between D8 and GND; the schematic agrees. No resistor is used. The sketch relies on the interrupt-wakeup pin.
The USB power source and micro-USB cable are listed in the manual but not shown in the circuit image, so they are not modelled.
